in_marathi.name: Bhisham
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Strong in the mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhisham हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhisham is a Sanskrit name that means 'strong in the mind'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhi' which means 'to be or to become' and 'sham' which means 'calm' or 'peaceful'. This name is associated with the sage Bhishma Pitamaha from Hindu mythology, who was known for his wisdom and courage.
